title: Felt stdlib: board algorithms and collections compiled to WASM
description: Implement the Felt standard library in Rust, compile to WASM, link into every Felt binary. Uses Layer 1 host imports for data access. Implements: collection ops (map, filter, fold, sort, combinations, etc.), set ops (union, intersect, difference), map ops (lookup, keys, values), board algorithms (flood_fill via BFS using adjacent imports, flood_groups, connected, border, border_owners, liberties, line_cells), grouping (group_by, count_groups, has_group). ~500 lines Rust → ~8KB WASM. Uses WASM GC for intermediate allocations (filtered arrays, flood fill visited sets, result records).
close_reason: Felt codegen wired to emit WASM host import calls for 35 builtins. AST scanning imports only used builtins. Alloc/dealloc exports for string ABI. 127 tests passing.
